query:
SELECT 
                id as "id!",
                date as "date: DateTime<Utc>",
                start_time as "start_time: DateTime<Utc>",
                end_time as "end_time: DateTime<Utc>",
                notes,
                feedback,
                timezone_offset_minutes,
                (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM exercises e
                    WHERE e.workout_id = workouts.id
                ) as "exercise_count!: i64"
            FROM workouts
            ORDER BY date DESC
